title: Research on Precision Medicine AI Algorithm for Neuro Immune Gastrointestinal Diseases based on Quantum Biochemistry and Computational Cancer Genetics.
authors: Li, Liangyu; Li, Bingyao; Wang, Guangwen; Li, Siyi; Li, Xudong; Santos, Javier; Gonzalez, Ana Maria; Guo, Lizhong; Tu, Yanyang; Qin, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学研究尼古丁与受体及TP53突变机制，并开发AI系统，但核心是神经免疫胃肠疾病与吸烟毒理，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: The objective of this study is to conduct network toxicology analysis based on smoking habits and develop a simpler and more effective toxicology product ingestion control system. BACKGROUND: Smoking behavior can affect the pathogenesis and prognosis of neuroimmune gastrointestinal diseases. AIMS: The purpose of developing tools to assist clinical practice is to avoid the harm of cigarettes to the human body. METHODS: Molecular dynamics method was used to elucidate the biophysical mechanism of TP53 gene mutation caused by harmful ingredients, and the signaling pathway of midbrain edge excitation was determined by molecular dynamics of nicotine and dopamine receptor D3. The possible involvement of nicotine in neuronal damage was determined through the molecular interaction between nicotine and ACHE. Molecular pathways were analyzed based on the aforementioned biological principles, developed artificial intelligence systems and brain computer interface systems. RESULTS: Several signaling pathways were elucidated, and effective AI algorithms were developed. CONCLUSION: The accuracy of artificial intelligence systems is over 70%. This study provides clinical doctors with a new precision medicine strategy and tool to regulate patient behavior and reduce disease risk. Other: This project was approved by the Ethics Committee of Chifeng Cancer Hospital and reported to the WHO.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究的目的是基于吸烟习惯进行网络毒理学分析，并开发一种更简单、更有效的毒理学产品摄入控制系统。背景：吸烟行为可影响神经免疫性胃肠疾病的发病机制和预后。目标：开发辅助临床实践的工具旨在避免香烟对人体的危害。方法：采用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 方法阐明有害成分导致TP53基因突变的生物物理机制，并通过尼古丁与多巴胺受体D3的分子动力学确定中脑边缘兴奋的信号通路。通过尼古丁与ACHE的分子相互作用确定尼古丁可能参与神经元损伤。基于上述生物学原理分析分子通路，开发人工智能系统和脑机接口系统。结果：阐明了若干信号通路，并开发了有效的人工智能算法。结论：人工智能系统的准确率超过70%。本研究为临床医生提供了一种新的精准医学策略和工具，以调节患者行为并降低疾病风险。其他：本项目经赤峰市肿瘤医院伦理委员会批准，并已向世界卫生组织报告。
